targets.delinquency: 60 or more days past due within 6 months, account current at snapshot
targets.bankruptcy: bankruptcy filing within 6 months, account current at snapshot

features.name: payroll_gap_days
features.reason_text: Length of time since the last regular payroll deposit
features.description: Days since the most recent payroll credit beyond a normal monthly cycle: max(days - 31, 0). Zero for anyone paid within the last 31 days, so it does not move with month length. Missing when there is no payroll relationship or the last payroll is more than 120 days old.
features.missing_text: No regular payroll deposits on record with us

features.name: payroll_amt_ratio_3m
features.description: Payroll credited in the last 3 months divided by the 3-month average of the 6 months before that.
features.missing_text: No regular payroll deposits on record with us

features.name: payroll_missed_cycles_3m
features.description: Expected payroll count (from the prior 6 months) minus payroll credits received in the last 3 months.
features.missing_text: No regular payroll deposits on record with us

features.name: inflow_ratio_3m
features.reason_text: Decrease in total income deposited to the account
features.description: Income-like credits (payroll, benefits, other income) in the last 3 months versus the 6 months before. Uses the amount of income from all sources and never which source it came from.
features.missing_text: No regular income deposits on record with us

features.name: transfer_in_share_3m
features.reason_text: Share of deposits arriving by transfer from other accounts
features.description: External transfers in divided by all credits over 3 months.
features.missing_text: No regular income deposits on record with us

features.name: buffer_days
features.reason_text: Deposit balance low relative to monthly spending
features.description: Month-end balance divided by average daily outflow over the last 3 months.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: buffer_days_change_6m
features.reason_text: Decline in deposit balance relative to spending
features.description: Change in buffer_days compared with 6 months earlier.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: min_balance_ratio_3m
features.description: Lowest end-of-day balance in the last 3 months divided by average monthly outflow.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: od_count_3m
features.description: Overdraft fees assessed in the last 3 months.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: od_months_6m
features.description: Months with at least one overdraft in the last 6.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: neg_days_3m
features.reason_text: Number of days with a negative deposit balance
features.description: Days ending with a negative balance in the last 3 months.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: stl_months_6m
features.description: Months with proceeds from a short-term lender in the last 6.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: ext_debt_pay_ratio_3m
features.reason_text: Payments to other lenders high relative to income deposited
features.description: Payments to other lenders divided by income-like credits over 3 months.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: ext_debt_pay_change_3m
features.reason_text: Change in payments to other lenders
features.description: Payments to other lenders in the last 3 months versus the 6 months before.
features.missing_text: No deposit account history with us

features.name: disc_spend_ratio_3m
features.description: Discretionary spend (card and debit) in the last 3 months versus the 6 months before.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: utilization
features.reason_text: Balance high relative to credit limit
features.description: Statement balance divided by credit limit.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: util_change_3m
features.reason_text: Recent increase in balance relative to credit limit
features.description: Utilization now minus utilization 3 months ago.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: util_change_6m
features.reason_text: Increase in balance relative to credit limit over six months
features.description: Utilization now minus utilization 6 months ago.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: pay_ratio_3m
features.description: Payments over 3 months divided by the statement balances they were due on.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: pay_to_min_3m
features.reason_text: Payments close to the minimum amount due
features.description: Payments over 3 months divided by minimum payments due.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: min_pay_months_6m
features.reason_text: Number of months only the minimum payment was made
features.description: Months in the last 6 with a payment at or within 10% of the minimum while carrying a balance.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: pay_ratio_drift
features.description: Payment ratio over the last 3 months minus the payment ratio over the 6 months before.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: cash_adv_to_limit_3m
features.description: Cash advances in the last 3 months divided by credit limit.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: cash_adv_months_6m
features.description: Months with a cash advance in the last 6.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: late_fee_count_6m
features.description: Late fees assessed in the last 6 months.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: card_spend_ratio_3m
features.description: Card purchases in the last 3 months versus the 6 months before.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: max_cpd_12m
features.description: Highest number of cycles past due in the last 12 months (the account is current at the snapshot).
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: statement_balance
features.description: Statement balance in dollars.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate

features.name: open_to_buy
features.description: Credit limit minus statement balance in dollars.
features.missing_text: Insufficient recent card activity to evaluate
